title: CU Potter's Club Membership
pay_text: Session fee of $200; cash, Venmo, or checks accepted
how_to_join: Fill out membership application; previous independent ceramics studio experience required; limited spaces available at start of each session
commitment: At least 2 hours per month committee service for 4 months per session; contribute 3 pieces per term to sales
summary: Members have 24/7 access to the studio and its electric kiln, with bisque and glaze firings handled by the firing committee. Previous independent studio experience required.
source_quote: Membership to the CUPC is session-based. There are three sessions per year— Spring, Summer, and Fall. The membership fee is $200 per session.
evidence_sentence: The membership page describes a firing committee that performs regular bisque and glaze firings in the studio's Cone 6 electric kiln.
evidence_quote: The firing committee usually consists of five people whose primary responsibility is to regularly perform bisque- and glazeware firings in our cone 6 electric kiln.
